First and foremost, Donald Trump and the Republicans lost, because in the 2024 campaign they promised American citizens very different things, namely peace and social security. Exactly the opposite happened.
More wars were started, which drove the cost of living in America to exorbitant heights. This is the payback for that.

AfD co-leader Tino Chrupalla on Trump’s defeat:
Above all, his promise to end the Ukraine war on the first day. We are now in the middle of his term, and he still hasn’t been able to end the war.
He started more wars, like the Iran war, which led to the closure of the Strait of Hormuz. Energy prices in America went through the roof, the cost of living rose drastically, and Americans did not forgive the Republicans for that.
That is the payback when you don’t keep election promises.
